component.name: MyMusik
component.summary: Play and organize your own music collection

description.p: MyMusik plays and organizes your own music collection. Import local audio, browse albums and artists, build playlists, and edit track details and artwork. Local playback works offline without an account.
Optional cloud synchronization, community features and AI assistance require an account and internet access.

MyMusik’s file chooser can see your Music folder by default. To import from another folder, grant read access with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/music:ro app.mymusik.MyMusik, then restart MyMusik. To remove all user overrides for this app, run flatpak override --user --reset app.mymusik.MyMusik.
